title: Orsen and the Echo
author: Cyrus Ravensworth
blurb: Tamsin Ishikawa, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
